title: The Sherman wagon house and stable behind 2100 Prairie
items: Behind 2100 Prairie, the Sherman house at the 21st Street corner, now stands one long two-storey brick building on the alley: a wagon house at its north end and a stable at its south, 22.5 m along the alley and 10.7 m deep, as the 1911 fire-insurance map draws it.

It is roofed the way that map plans it, slate hips rising from every wall to a flat felted deck, in place of the draft's notched block under a gable. Two carriage doors open onto the alley from the wagon house, a man door and stable windows from the stable, with loft windows above.
